purpose: Production-oriented visual assets extracted from the supplied Feeder mobile login reference. This is an asset pack, not a poster.

recommended_usage.hero-background.webp: Top visual background behind real HTML logo/text; object-fit: cover.
recommended_usage.hero-animals-mountains.webp: Hero visual asset for the animal section.
recommended_usage.bottom-leaves-background.webp: Lower decorative background behind real HTML footer.
recommended_usage.feature-icons: Six separate circular feature icon assets. Keep labels as real HTML text for responsive alignment.
recommended_usage.action-icon-references: Reference crops for Email, Google, Apple, Arrow and Globe. Replace with official SVGs if available.

important: The uploaded source is a flattened mockup, so the extracted assets are reference-derived.
For production, original Feeder SVG/logo and official Google/Apple icon assets should replace the reference crops where available.
Do not use the full uploaded screenshot as the login UI background.
